title: 2025上海马拉松竞赛规程
claims: The 2025 Shanghai Marathon takes place on Sunday 30 November 2025; the wheelchair marathon starts at 06:45 and the marathon and fitness run start at 07:00.
The marathon starts at the Bund Bull (外滩金牛广场) and finishes at Xujiahui Sports Park; the fitness run finishes at the Shanghai Exhibition Centre.

The organiser lists the route as passing the Bund, Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, Jing'an Temple, Huaihai Road, Xintiandi, Longteng Avenue and Longhua Road, with detailed routing subject to publication before the race.
Drink stations begin at 5 km and continue every 5 km; water stations begin at 7.5 km and continue every 5 km through 40 km.
The June 2025 rules list cut-offs at 10 km 08:30, 15 km 09:10, 20 km 09:50, 25 km 10:30, 30 km 11:15, 35 km 12:05, 40 km 12:50 and the finish at 13:15.
Runners may enter the start area from 05:30; bag deposit closes at 06:45 and bag collection at the finish is available until 14:30.
Marathon finishers within 6 hours 15 minutes receive a finisher medal.
Timing mats are placed at the start, every 5 km, at the 21.0975 km halfway point, at turnarounds and at the finish.
Medical stations are fixed at the start, the finish and along the course, with ambulances following the race.
The race is technically certified by the Chinese Athletics Association and conducted under World Athletics rules.
The 2025 field is 23,000 marathon runners, 15,000 fitness-run runners and about 20 wheelchair athletes.
The start uses a split-gun (multi-wave) format.
